title: Garmin Forerunner 265/265s Watch $499 Delivered / C&C (Online Only) @ Rebel
body:

[BargainHunterMYz] Once you see the $499 garmin forerunner 965 deal earlier today, you can't unsee it.

[JustValerie] Some like myself being small female prefer more elegant 265, it is a deal. Oh, and that deal didn't last long anyway huh
